speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what is HDB's current practice for effecting repairs and redecoration (R&R) works for multi-storey car parks (MSCPs) when there are concurrent R&R works in the precinct; (b) whether there are any guidelines on the maximum duration for R&R works on precinct housing blocks and their MSCPs to differ; and (c) whether HDB will consider a system where Town Councils bid for R&R works for MSCPs alongside precinct tenders, with proportionate cost-sharing.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: Just a little context for why this was brought up.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: I am sure, as herself and other Members of this House would have experienced, we have received feedback about seemingly dilapidated MSCPs and that is because they happen to fall substantially outside of the cycle.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: I appreciate that from the perspective of HDB, it absolutely makes sense to bundle these together for economies of scale.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: Which is why I wonder, whether to exploit the same economies of scale, it can be more or less standardised that TC can just make a request from HDB to enfold the R&R works for MSCPs into the R&R cycle for neighbouring clusters.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: So, my understanding is that this is possible.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: But the Senior Minister of State is saying that this is on a case-by-case basis, that they have to apply for it?
